summary.text: Roman Kozak is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 14 who has served since December 1, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He worked as an educator before entering the legislature.

paragraphs.text: Roman Kozak graduated from Bethel Park High School in 2006 and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Geneva College in 2011.
His career experience includes working as an educator.
Kozak assumed office on December 1, 2024, succeeding Jim Marshall.
